segments.text: And it came to pass at that time, that Judah went down from his brethren, and turned in to a certain Adullamite, whose name was Hirah.
And Judah saw there a daughter of a certain Canaanite, whose name was Shuah; and he took her, and went in unto her.
And she conceived, and bare a son; and he called his name Er.
And she conceived again, and bare a son; and she called his name Onan.
And she yet again conceived, and bare a son; and called his name Shelah: and he was at Chezib, when she bare him.
And Judah took a wife for Er his firstborn, whose name was Tamar.
And Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in the sight of the LORD;

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: and the LORD slew him.
And Judah said unto Onan,

segments.speaker: Judah
segments.text: Go in unto thy brother’s wife, and marry her, and raise up seed to thy brother.
And Onan knew that the seed should not be his; and it came to pass, when he went in unto his brother’s wife, that he spilled it on the ground, lest that he should give seed to his brother.
And the thing which he did displeased the LORD:

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: wherefore he slew him also.

footnotes.text: + displeased…: Heb. was evil in the eyes of the Lord

segments.text: Then said Judah to Tamar his daughter in law,

segments.speaker: Judah
segments.text: Remain a widow at thy father’s house, till Shelah my son be grown: for he said, Lest peradventure he die also, as his brethren did.
And Tamar went and dwelt in her father’s house.
¶ And in process of time the daughter of Shuah Judah’s wife died; and Judah was comforted, and went up unto his sheepshearers to Timnath, he and his friend Hirah the Adullamite.

footnotes.text: + in process…: Heb. the days were multiplied

segments.text: And it was told Tamar, saying, Behold thy father in law goeth up to Timnath to shear his sheep.

And she put her widow’s garments off from her, and covered her with a vail, and wrapped herself, and sat in an open place, which is by the way to Timnath; for she saw that Shelah was grown, and she was not given unto him to wife.

footnotes.text: + an open…: Heb. the door of eyes, or, of Enajim

segments.text: When Judah saw her, he thought her to be an harlot; because she had covered her face.
And he turned unto her by the way, and said,

segments.speaker: Judah
segments.text: Go to, I pray thee, let me come in unto thee; (for he knew not that she was his daughter in law.)
And she said,

segments.speaker: Tamar
segments.text: What wilt thou give me, that thou mayest come in unto me?
And he said,

segments.speaker: Judah
segments.text: I will send thee a kid from the flock.
And she said,

segments.speaker: Tamar
segments.text: Wilt thou give me a pledge, till thou send it?

footnotes.text: + a kid: Heb. a kid of the goats

segments.text: And he said,

segments.speaker: Judah
segments.text: What pledge shall I give thee?
And she said,

segments.speaker: Tamar
segments.text: Thy signet, and thy bracelets, and thy staff that is in thine hand.
And he gave it her, and came in unto her, and she conceived by him.
And she arose, and went away, and laid by her vail from her, and put on the garments of her widowhood.
And Judah sent the kid by the hand of his friend the Adullamite, to receive his pledge from the woman’s hand: but he found her not.
Then he asked the men of that place, saying,

segments.speaker: Hirah
segments.text: Where is the harlot, that was openly by the way side?
And they said,

segments.speaker: Men of the place
segments.text: There was no harlot in this place.
And he returned to Judah, and said,

segments.speaker: Hirah
segments.text: I cannot find her; and also the men of the place said, that there was no harlot in this place.
And Judah said,

segments.speaker: Judah
segments.text: Let her take it to her, lest we be shamed: behold, I sent this kid, and thou hast not found her.

footnotes.text: + be shamed: Heb. become a contempt

segments.text: ¶ And it came to pass about three months after, that it was told Judah, saying,

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: Tamar thy daughter in law hath played the harlot; and also, behold, she is with child by whoredom.
And Judah said,

segments.speaker: Judah
segments.text: Bring her forth, and let her be burnt.
When she was brought forth, she sent to her father in law, saying,

segments.speaker: Tamar
segments.text: By the man, whose these are, am I with child: and she said, Discern, I pray thee, whose are these, the signet, and bracelets, and staff.
And Judah acknowledged them, and said,

segments.speaker: Judah
segments.text: She hath been more righteous than I; because that I gave her not to Shelah my son.
And he knew her again no more.
¶ And it came to pass in the time of her travail, that, behold, twins were in her womb.
And it came to pass, when she travailed, that the one put out his hand: and the midwife took and bound upon his hand a scarlet thread, saying,

segments.speaker: Midwife
segments.text: This came out first.
And it came to pass, as he drew back his hand, that, behold, his brother came out: and she said,

segments.speaker: Midwife
segments.text: How hast thou broken forth? this breach be upon thee: therefore his name was called Pharez.

footnotes.text: + How hast…: or, Wherefore hast thou made this breach against thee?

segments.text: And afterward came out his brother, that had the scarlet thread upon his hand: and his name was called Zarah.
